name: Hu tieu muc
summary: Hủ tiếu mực is pork-bone and dried-squid broth with squid, shrimp, fish cake, and quail eggs. Vietnam Tourism calls it a local breakfast and serves it with herbs, bean sprouts, and lime.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism’s local-eating article and the Mediterranean article both name squid noodle soup. A street was not printed.
taste: Vietnam Tourism calls the broth naturally sweet and umami, from pork bones and dried squid.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl, with lime and bean sprouts beside it.
Vietnam Tourism calls it breakfast. A street, an hour, and a price were not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street. Check on arrival.
